rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an academic exam and for an exam-like standardized test.

example.english: I have an English test tomorrow, so I need to study tonight.
example.traditional: 我聽日有英文考試，今晚要溫書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 jing1 man4 haau2 si5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 wan1 syu1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for checking something or putting its performance or strength under strain.

example.english: We need to test whether the new air conditioner can hold up in high temperatures.
example.traditional: 我哋要測試部新冷氣喺高溫下頂唔頂得順。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cak1 si3 bou6 san1 laang5 hei3 hai2 gou1 wan1 haa6 ding2 m4 ding2 dak1 seon6

rows.note: Use this for testing a product, piece of equipment, or system to see how it performs.

example.english: This new phone needs a few more test rounds before it can go on sale.
example.traditional: 呢部新手機仲要做幾輪測試，先至可以出街。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 zung6 jiu3 zou6 gei2 leon4 cak1 si3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for giving or conducting an academic examination, especially in a school context.

example.english: The teacher will test us next week.
example.traditional: 老師下星期要幫我哋考試。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 haau2 si5

rows.note: Use this for a difficult trial or ordeal that challenges someone or something.

example.english: This long trip is a real test of our stamina.
example.traditional: 呢次長途旅行真係考驗我哋嘅體力。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 coeng4 tou4 leoi5 hang4 zan1 hai6 haau2 jim6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tai2 lik6

rows.note: Use this for medical or laboratory testing, including finding that a result is positive or checking a substance with a reagent.

example.english: I need to test my blood tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 jim6 hyut3

rows.note: Use this colloquially when someone provocatively challenges another person to fight or confronts them.

example.english: Don't test me again, or I really will fight you.
example.traditional: 你唔好再挑機，唔係我真係會同你打。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 tiu1 gei1 m4 hai6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 wui5 tung4 nei5 daa2

rows.note: Use this for a standardized assessment or other measurement test rather than an ordinary school examination.

example.english: This personality test is quite fun; I want to know what type I am.
example.traditional: 呢份心理測驗幾有趣，我想知自己係咩類型。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 sam1 lei5 cak1 jim6 gei2 jau5 ceoi3 ngo5 soeng2 zi1 zi6 gei2 hai6 me1 leoi6 jing4
